summary: Frontend-only responsiveness verification across 13 routes × 6 breakpoints (320/375/768/1024/1440/1920). ALL routes pass the no-horizontal-scroll check (documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth). Admin mobile drawer, sticky top bar, drawer open/close via menu-btn AND overlay/close-btn, auto-close on route navigation, single nav-admin-blogs testid, and desktop-static-sidebar all verified. Admin tables (admin-blogs-table, properties-table, leads-table) have overflow-x:auto wrapper with min-width. MI filter bar at 375px scrolls horizontally with no-scrollbar; at 1440 wraps to exactly 2 rows with all 13 chips visible. Hero picture serves -mobile.webp at 375. Contact form stacks 1-col on mobile, splits to 2-col on desktop. Aramya iframe fills 375x812 viewport exactly. MI news grid populated (12 items). Property/Blog grids use correct responsive column classes.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid mismatch — spec expects [data-testid='mobile-menu-btn'] but actual element is [data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle']. Button itself works (aria-label='Open menu', visible on <lg) but testid does not match the review-request contract.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Rename data-testid on the public-site mobile hamburger from 'mobile-menu-toggle' to 'mobile-menu-btn' to match spec contract (or update spec). Button already renders and functions correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx correctly uses a single <aside> that toggles fixed/translated on mobile vs static on lg — no duplicated data-testids confirmed (nav-admin-blogs count = 1).
MI filter uses overflow-x-auto sm:overflow-visible + no-scrollbar; verified working (scrollWidth=1545 at 375px, wraps to 2 rows at 1440).
Admin table wrappers correctly apply overflow-x:auto and min-w-[520px] on <table>.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 13 routes verified overflow-free at 6 breakpoints. Admin drawer flow verified end-to-end at 375px. Only cosmetic finding: mobile-menu-btn testid on public header is actually 'mobile-menu-toggle'. Aramya iframe measured only at outer document (as instructed). Public-site mobile nav opens on click and shows Home/Properties/Market Intelligence/Blogs/About/Contact.
rca of the issue: Testid naming inconsistency between review-request contract ('mobile-menu-btn') and existing implementation ('mobile-menu-toggle'). No functional impact — button works, opens full-screen nav, all links visible. One-line fix: rename attribute in the mobile-header component or update spec.
